imageNotes.sourcingNote: Unsplash.com search pages are blocked in this build environment (HTTP 401 via curl; browser.open policy-blocked), so Unsplash IDs were taken from real Unsplash image URLs embedded in indexed pages found via web search, and Pexels IDs from real Pexels search pages fetched by curl. Every image was downloaded from images.unsplash.com / images.pexels.com and viewed before use; no ID is reused from design-log.json. Coordinator correction 2026-11-07: one ID had been reused (see rejected list) and was replaced; after the fix no ID is reused from design-log.json (verified by normalized check across imageIds + image_ids keys).

sources.note: ThreeBestRated Durham cafés listing page; Riverview Kitchen entry lists email, phone, address, hours and 4.8 rating with 116/120 inspection and 'Reviews Accuracy of 2.1K'.
Facebook is the business's only web presence. Guessed domains riverviewkitchen.co.uk and riverviewkitchendurham.co.uk do not resolve (curl HTTPS 000, verified 7 Nov 2026).
